library.emptyBody: Bring in your PDFs from Files, Drive or any folder. They stay on this device.
library.confirmDeleteBody: You can restore them from the Trash for 30 days.
library.noMatchBody: Try removing a filter to see more of your library.

setlists.emptyBody: Line up the songs for your next gig or service, then play straight through with your pedal.

collections.emptyBody: Group scores the way you think about them — by band, book, season or student.

settings.hapticsHint: Gentle ticks for scrubbing, reordering and page limits. Never on page turns.

reader.a11yHint: Swipe up or down to turn pages. Double-tap for controls.
reader.modeAutoHint: One page upright, two pages sideways on a tablet
reader.modeHalfHint: See the top of the next page while you finish this one
reader.performanceHint: Performance mode. To leave, hold the middle of the page for a second.
reader.annotateSoon: Annotation is coming in the next update.
reader.hintAnywhere: Tap anywhere for the next page
reader.missingTitle: This score isn't in your library any more
reader.missingBody: It may have been deleted. Check the Trash to restore it.
reader.unreadableBody: The file may be damaged or incomplete. Try importing it again from the original source.
reader.passwordBody: Protected PDFs can't be opened yet. Save an unlocked copy from the app that created it, then import that.

reading.pageTurnHint: How pedal and tap turns look. Swipes always follow your finger.
reading.tapSidesHint: Tap the left or right edge to turn; tap the middle for controls.
reading.tapAnywhereHint: Any tap turns forward; tap the top of the page for controls.
reading.defaultFilterHint: Used for every score unless you pick another in the score.
reading.volumeKeysHint: Volume down = next, volume up = previous, while reading.

pedals.title: Pedals
pedals.rowHint: Test your pedal and choose what each key does
pedals.pressToTest: Press your pedal — the matching tile lights up.
pedals.noDeviceHint: Pair it in Android's Bluetooth settings. It will show up here.
pedals.assignBody: Press the pedal or key now. Back cancels.
pedals.debounceHint: Stops a bouncy pedal from turning two pages at once.
pedals.keyboardBody: Android treats most pedals as a keyboard, so it hides the on-screen keyboard while one is connected. To type, switch the pedal off, or turn on “Show on-screen keyboard” in Android Settings › System › Keyboard › Physical keyboard.
pedals.detectedBody: It's ready to turn pages. Press it once to check.
pedals.detectedKeyboardNote: While a pedal is connected, Android may hide the on-screen keyboard.

search.noResultsBody: Check the spelling, or search by composer, tag or a word from the notes.

import.title: Import scores
import.filesHint: One or more PDFs from Files, Drive or any app
import.privacy: Copies stay on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
import.pickFailed: Couldn't open the file picker. Please try again.
import.reviewImportedHint: Titles and composers were read from the file names. Fix anything that looks off.

reasons.noSpace: Not enough storage on this device
reasons.copy: The file couldn't be read. If it's in the cloud, check your connection and try again.

details.title: Title
details.batchHint: Only the fields you fill in are changed. Tags are added to each score.

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Scores stay here for 30 days before they're deleted for good.
trash.confirmBody: The PDF and everything you added to it will be removed from this device. This can't be undone.
trash.emptyBody: Scores you delete wait here for 30 days, in case you change your mind.
